text_en: When Jeremiah finished speaking to all the people all these words of the Lord their God, with which the Lord their God had sent him to them,
text_cn: 耶肋米亚向全体人民说完上主他们的天主的一切话，即上主他们的天主派遣他来向他们转告的这一切话以后，

text_en: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the other insolent men said to Jeremiah, “You are telling a lie. The Lord our God did not send you to say, ‘Do not go to Egypt to settle there’;
text_cn: 玛阿色雅的儿子阿匝黎雅和卡勒亚的儿子约哈南，以及一切傲慢反叛的人，就对耶肋米亚说：“你说谎；上主我们的天主并没有派你说：你们不要去寄居在埃及；

text_en: but Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us, to hand us over to the Chaldeans, in order that they may kill us or take us into exile in Babylon. ”
text_cn: 只是乃黎雅的儿子巴路克挑唆你反对我们，好将我们交在加色丁人手中，或杀或掳到巴比伦去。”

text_en: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces and all the people did not obey the voice of the Lord , to stay in the land of Judah.
text_cn: 卡勒亚的儿子约哈南和众部队首领以及全体人民，没有听从上主的劝告，住在犹大地内。

text_en: But Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took all the remnant of Judah who had returned to settle in the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been driven—
text_cn: 卡勒亚的儿子约哈南和众部队首领，反而率领全体犹大遗民，即那些四散到各民族间，又回来住在犹大境内的人：

text_en: the men, the women, the children, the princesses, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan; also the prophet Jeremiah and Baruch son of Neriah.
text_cn: 男子和妇女，幼童和王家闺秀，以及卫队长乃步匝辣当给沙番的孙子，阿希甘的儿子留下的人，连同先知耶肋米亚和乃黎雅的儿子巴路克，

text_en: And they came into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of the Lord . And they arrived at Tahpanhes.
text_cn: 到埃及地去了；没有听从上主的劝告，而来到塔黑培乃斯。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes:
text_cn: 在塔黑培乃斯上主有话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Take some large stones in your hands, and bury them in the clay pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes. Let the Judeans see you do it,
text_cn: “你用手拿一些大石头，当着犹大人眼前，藏在塔黑培乃斯法郎王宫门前石铺地道下面，

text_en: and say to them, Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I am going to send and take my servant King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon, and he will set his throne above these stones that I have buried, and he will spread his royal canopy over them.
text_cn: 然后对他们说：万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：看，我必派人去领我的仆人巴比伦王拿步高来，在你藏的这些石头上安置他的宝座，张设他的华盖。

text_en: He shall come and ravage the land of Egypt, giving those who are destined for pestilence, to pestilence, and those who are destined for captivity, to captivity, and those who are destined for the sword, to the sword.
text_cn: 他必来攻打埃及地，叫那该死的死，该掳的掳，该杀的杀；

text_en: He shall kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them and carry them away captive; and he shall pick clean the land of Egypt, as a shepherd picks his cloak clean of vermin; and he shall depart from there safely.
text_cn: 必来放火焚烧埃及的神庙，烧毁或掳走庙内的神像；必来收取埃及地，如同牧人收取自己的外衣，最后安然离去。

text_en: He shall break the obelisks of Heliopolis, which is in the land of Egypt; and the temples of the gods of Egypt he shall burn with fire.
text_cn: 此外，他还要粉碎埃及地太阳神庙的石柱，放火焚烧埃及的神庙。”
